children: Aerodrome’s tokenized stock trading volume has crossed $250 million in just two weeks. If the histogram trend continues, $300 million could be the next target for Aerodrome on Base. The numbers are getting attention, but the token still has plenty to prove.
Aerodrome Stock Trading Gains Fresh Momentum

Token Terminal showed that Aerodrome on Base surpassed $250 million in cumulative tokenized stock trading volume over the past two weeks. The activity follows previous post related to its trading marketplace, where blue-chip U.S. stocks are now live.

The newly available stocks include Amazon, Microsoft, Strategy, SanDisk, SpaceX and Tesla. That gives users access to a broader selection of familiar names through Aerodrome’s marketplace, although higher trading volume alone doesn’t guarantee stronger token performance.
The next measurable milestone is $300 million. Based on the rising histogram, that level could arrive if the current trading trend continues.
Aerodrome Revenue Improves, But Emissions Matter

Blockworks’ dashboard shows Aerodrome revenue increasing during the latest week, with the histogram indicating improving business activity. For AERO holders, that suggests revenue generation has been moving in a more positive direction.

However, the emissions-to-revenue ratio has also risen. Based on the latest epoch, the ratio stands at 1.75, compared with a low of 0.29. That means emissions remain a significant factor when assessing the protocol’s economics.

Aerodrome’s net income has improved substantially from its earlier losses. Between November 29 and December 5, 2024, weekly losses reached approximately $10 million. In 2026, net income has hovered around negative $1 million, but the broader trend shows a clear reduction in losses. That’s progress. But, It’s just not the same as consistent profitability.
AERO Price Still Faces Major Resistance Levels

AERO’s long-term price action remains trapped within a broad falling wedge that began after the April 2024 peak near $2.35. A late-2024 rally retested that resistance but failed to break it decisively.

The bear market then pushed AERO/USD toward the $0.30 demand area in 2025. A recovery followed, reaching approx. $1.60 by August 2025, before another decline sent the token back toward $0.30 in early February 2026.
This time, the recovery has been slower. AERO price is now following an ascending trendline and testing the $0.54 resistance area during Q3 2026.
A successful breakout could open the way toward $0.85, followed by $1.20, $1.60 and potentially $2.35 by year-end. But the chart still offers several ways for bullish expectations to fail.

If $0.54 continues to reject price, then AERO price could finish the year below that level and revisit $0.30. Even a move above $0.54 and toward $0.85 wouldn’t settle the matter. Rejection at $0.85 could send the token back to $0.54, while losing that support could expose the $0.30 demand zone.

For now, Aerodrome has improving trading activity, better revenue trends and a major stock-market expansion. Whether those developments can push AERO token price beyond $0.54 remains the market’s next test.
